components_chart_cancel: A Chart.js animator function that cancels an in-progress animation for a target.
components_chart_clear: A Chart.js function that clears cached values and prepares the canvas before redrawing.
components_chart_computeticklimit: A Chart.js scale function that computes the maximum number of ticks that can fit given the scale's dimensions.
components_chart_converttickstolabels: A Chart.js scale function that converts raw tick values into their formatted display label strings.
components_chart_count: A minified Luxon-derived DateTime helper bundled with Chart.js's date adapter, used near diff and startOf operations.
components_chart_createdescriptors: A Chart.js configuration function that creates cached property descriptors for resolving option values through a config proxy.
components_chart_da: A minified Chart.js helper function used in the render/update pipeline, invoked near notifyPlugins and render.
components_chart_describe: A Chart.js registry function that attaches descriptive metadata to a registered element or controller type.
components_chart_drawbackground: A Chart.js tooltip function that draws the tooltip's background box on the canvas.
components_chart_drawdataset: A Chart.js controller function that draws a single dataset's elements onto the canvas.
components_chart_drawgrid: A Chart.js radial scale function that draws the grid lines on a radar or polar chart.
components_chart_ee: A minified Chart.js configuration helper used for creating option resolvers and resolving named option sets.
components_chart_eventhandler: An internal Chart.js function that processes a chart-level DOM event and triggers a re-render if needed.
components_chart_formatdatetimefromstrin: A Luxon-derived date formatting function bundled with Chart.js's date adapter that formats a date according to a token string.
components_chart_fromformat: A Luxon-derived DateTime parsing function bundled with Chart.js's date adapter that parses a string according to a given format.
components_chart_fromformatparser: A Luxon-derived helper bundled with Chart.js's date adapter that builds the token parser used by fromFormat.
components_chart_fromopts: A Luxon-derived DateTime constructor helper bundled with Chart.js's date adapter that builds a date from parsed options.
components_chart_getdatatimestamps: A Chart.js time scale function that collects all timestamps present across the visible datasets.
components_chart_getdatavisibility: A Chart.js controller function that checks whether a specific data point is currently visible.
components_chart_getlabelandvalue: A Chart.js dataset controller function that returns the formatted label and value pair for a data point, used by tooltips.
components_chart_getlabelcapacity: A Chart.js scale function that computes the maximum number of tick labels that fit in the available space.
components_chart_getlabeltimestamps: A Chart.js time scale function that computes the timestamps used to generate axis tick labels.
components_chart_getmindaysinfirstweek: A Luxon-derived locale helper bundled with Chart.js's date adapter that returns the minimum number of days required in the first week of a year.
components_chart_getpixelfordecimal: A Chart.js scale function that converts a 0-to-1 decimal proportion into a pixel position along the axis.
components_chart_getpixelfortick: A Chart.js scale function that returns the pixel position corresponding to a given tick index.
components_chart_getpointlabelcontext: A Chart.js radial scale function that builds the context object passed to point-label rendering callbacks.
components_chart_getpointpositionforvalu: A Chart.js radial scale function that computes a point's pixel position for a given data value at a given index.
components_chart_getrotationextents: A Chart.js pie/doughnut controller function that computes the minimum and maximum rotation across all datasets.
components_chart_getruler: A Chart.js bar controller function that computes pixel ruler metrics (spacing, thickness) used to position bars.
components_chart_getsharedoptions: A Chart.js function that retrieves cached style options shared across multiple elements to avoid recomputation.
components_chart_getstyle: A Chart.js function that returns the resolved visual style (color, point style) for a dataset or legend label.
components_chart_gf: A minified Chart.js radial scale helper used near getDistanceFromCenterForValue and getPointPositionForValue.
components_chart_init: A Chart.js scale initialization function that sets up parsing and label generation for the scale.
components_chart_jd: A minified Chart.js layout helper invoked before the layout phase.
components_chart_jf: A minified helper function in Chart.js.
components_chart_kr: A minified Chart.js scale helper used near computeTickLimit and setDimensions.
components_chart_lc: A minified Luxon-derived DateTime helper bundled with Chart.js's date adapter, used near fromObject and offset.
components_chart_lr: A minified Chart.js canvas drawing helper used near pathSegment for rendering curved or straight line segments.
components_chart_ne: A minified Chart.js tooltip drawing helper used alongside drawBody, drawFooter and drawTitle.
components_chart_nearest: A Chart.js interaction function that finds the chart element nearest to a given event position.
